$comment: Golden corpus for the manual-parser eval. Each entry addresses a real manual in the live project by home_id + manual_id; the runner resolves the PDF from Firebase Storage (read-only) and caches it under .pdf-cache/. `model` mirrors what pickParseModel would choose for that item, so the eval exercises the same model production would.
selection_criteria: CAPABILITY COVERAGE, not head-count. Every entry is here because it exercises something the others do not: an install/service manual, a fire-safety task, a consumable-vs-maintenance trap, a manufacturer-stated interval, a low-task fixture that invites over-generation.

The Opus escalation path IS exercised — furnace-york has item_category subType 'hvac-furnace', which pickParseModel escalates. (The old scripts/parse-eval README claims this coverage was lost; that note is stale.)
Small appliances outnumber major ones because that is where the curation failures actually happened — 'Replace Water in the Tank' as an Essential task came from a coffee machine, not a furnace.

Manuals whose sourceRef still points at the deleted v1 Supabase project are permanently unrecoverable and are NOT listed: the gas range, a refrigerator, a dishwasher, the Cafe range and a microwave. That is a real coverage gap — see BASELINE.md.

manuals.name: furnace-york
manuals.covers: install/service manual; combustion safety; the ONE canonical must-never-lose task (filter). Also the only entry on the Opus escalation path.

manuals.name: dryer-lg
manuals.covers: fire-safety maintenance (lint trap, vent run) that must never be demoted, alongside cosmetic cleaning that must not be inflated. Both directions of care_type in one manual.

manuals.name: washer-lg
manuals.covers: setup-vs-recurring discrimination (leveling is setup; tub clean is recurring), door-seal care, supply-hose inspection.

manuals.name: nespresso-vertuo
manuals.covers: THE trigger case. This manual once produced 'Replace Water in the Tank' as an Essential task. Descaling must survive; every consumable top-up must not.

manuals.name: foodcycler
manuals.covers: tier inflation (a prior run had 50% essential) against a filter task that must survive curation.

manuals.name: range-hood-zline
manuals.covers: grease filters and duct/airflow — the NEVER DROP category, on an appliance where neglect is a fire risk.

manuals.name: air-purifier-coway
manuals.covers: schedule fidelity. This manual states explicit intervals for several distinct filters; softening any of them to as_needed is the failure mode.

manuals.name: ceiling-fan-haiku
manuals.appliance: Big Ass Fans Haiku L ceiling fan
manuals.covers: the over-generation trap: a fixture with almost no genuine upkeep. A parser that invents tasks shows it here.

manuals.name: ninja-creami
manuals.covers: operation-vs-upkeep on an appliance that is almost entirely operation — freezing pints and spinning them is using it, not maintaining it.

manuals.name: blender-kitchenaid
manuals.covers: essential-tier discipline on an appliance with no genuine safety-critical upkeep at all.

manuals.name: blender-beast
manuals.covers: a second small appliance of the same class as the KitchenAid, to separate model variance from a real regression.

manuals.name: dishwasher-thermador
manuals.covers: the appliance class that started the curation work: the filter is real maintenance, while detergent, rinse aid and salt are operation. Also a SECOND home, proving the corpus is not single-tenant.
